gloss: boisterous revelry; noisy partying; rowdy merrymaking

definitions.gloss: boisterous revelry; noisy partying; rowdy merrymaking
definitions.explanation: Loud, exuberant celebration or partying, typically involving drinking, singing, and general noise. Often implies excessive or disruptive merriment.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}でどんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎをしている。
examples.english: They're having a rowdy party next door.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|さくや}はどんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎで{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep last night because of the rowdy revelry.

examples.japanese: {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}で{朝|あさ}までどんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎをした。
examples.english: We partied rowdily until morning at the year-end party.

notes:
"どんちゃん" is an onomatopoeic expression imitating the sounds of drums and cymbals ({太鼓|たいこ}のドンドンと{鉦|かね}のチャンチャン), suggesting festive noise.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎをする — to have a rowdy party
- どんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎになる — to turn into a rowdy scene

The word has a slightly negative or exasperated tone when used by someone not participating, but a fun, self-deprecating tone when used by the participants themselves.
